description: Visibility-domain point-source test of the CP-72 2713 Band 7 flagged window, on an independent re-calibration of the first execution block. Models compared: no source; a point source at the stellar position; a point source anywhere in the primary beam. The local continuum is subtracted from the drifting channel using neighbouring channels, so the star's own continuum is not mistaken for a narrowband excess.
note: The grid maximum over 961 trial positions reaches 4.4-5.4 at control frequencies, so a 5.5 excess found by a grid search would be unremarkable; what is not is that the flagged frequency is the only one whose best-fit position coincides with the star, and that the statistic AT the pre-specified stellar position is 5.50 against |A_star_snr| <= 1.7 at every control frequency.
